set_privacy_text:
1. DATA COLLECTION & USAGE
Prime Breeder collects minimal necessary data to provide kennel management services. Your data is encrypted and securely stored on our cloud infrastructure.

2. ACCOUNT DELETION & DATA RETENTION
You can request permanent account deletion from Settings, subject to identity verification and confirmation. The application's deletion process removes your private account data and owned content/media. Some shared or community content may be anonymized or redacted rather than deleted where necessary to preserve conversations, records or system integrity. Limited information may be retained where reasonably necessary for legal obligations, security, fraud or abuse prevention, deletion records or service integrity, and the separately disclosed support-message retention. Third-party/provider retention may apply as already disclosed. Deletion does not mean that every record disappears immediately.

3. CONTACT SUPPORT
To receive and respond to support requests, troubleshoot issues, prevent abuse and secure the support channel, Prime Breeder processes your support message, authenticated account email where available (or a limited account reference), platform, server timestamp and limited security metadata. Resend delivers support emails to the operator’s support inbox. Only a verified account email is used as Reply-To. Operational records contain hashed account/request identifiers, a message/context fingerprint, attempt counts, timestamps and delivery status, not the message or raw email. Their expiry is set to 48 hours after the latest attempt; database removal depends on TTL configuration and asynchronous processing. Email-provider data and messages in the operator’s inbox have separate retention; this expiry does not delete those emails. For support and privacy enquiries: support@primebreeder.net.

Prime Breeder is operated by Jovan Trajkovski, a natural person in North Macedonia, who is the data controller. Public contact: support@primebreeder.net.

Support correspondence may be retained for up to 12 months after the last support communication. Longer retention is permitted only where reasonably necessary for legal obligations, dispute handling, fraud or abuse investigations, or security incidents. This correspondence retention is separate from temporary rate-limit/idempotency metadata; Firestore TTL does not delete delivered emails. The operator must apply this correspondence retention policy separately in the support inbox.

Smart Scan (optional)
When you choose a pedigree image for Smart Scan, the complete selected image is sent over encrypted connections through our authenticated server to Google Cloud Vision for text recognition. This includes any owner or breeder details visible on the document, although only dog names are proposed for the pedigree fields. Choose only documents you are entitled to process. Scanning is optional; manual pedigree entry remains available.
We use synchronous processing: our scanner processes the image and OCR response in server memory, without saving them to Cloud Storage or Firestore or including them in ordinary server logs. Google states that synchronous Vision images are processed in memory, are not made public and are not used to train its models; Google temporarily records request metadata for service operation and abuse prevention. Google Cloud acts as our processing service provider under its Cloud Data Processing Addendum. Processing is not guaranteed to remain in your country.
Temporary app-private image copies are removed after the scan when possible; the original image you selected is unchanged. Minimal account-linked operation records (image hash, request ID, time, status and quota counters) are retained to prevent duplicate charges and enforce allowances, until account deletion under our existing deletion process. These records contain no image or recognized names. Aggregate service counters contain no user ID. Recognition results are proposed for review; only names you approve and Save become part of your existing pedigree records, subject to their normal retention and deletion rules. For privacy requests contact support@primebreeder.net.

Community text, including private messages and private rooms, is checked automatically before publication. Owners and moderators cannot browse private conversations through moderation tools. Automated checks may make mistakes; use Help & support or Request review to dispute a restriction. Only account-linked moderation metadata is kept for abuse prevention and review; rejected private-message text is not stored in moderation logs.

repro_estimate_note: Planning estimate only; it does not confirm pregnancy. Birth may occur outside this window. Review timing with your vet, especially if the window has passed.
repro_no_dates: No usable mating, ovulation or LH/initial-rise date recorded.
repro_unknown_unit_help: Check the original laboratory report and select its unit before saving. The current display setting cannot identify the unit of an old record.
repro_threshold_review: Custom ranges need review in Settings: their original unit is missing or the values are invalid. Confirm the original unit and save valid ranges. No custom interpretation is available yet.
repro_invalid_thresholds: Enter six valid, non-negative limits in strictly increasing order.
repro_invalid_test: Enter a valid non-negative value, confirm its unit and use a valid test date that is not in the future.
repro_invalid_dates: Enter at least one valid recorded date (DD/MM/YYYY), not a future date.
repro_invalid_order: The recorded LH/initial rise cannot be after the recorded ovulation date. Check the dates with your vet.
repro_date_help: Enter actual mating/insemination and, if available, veterinarian-estimated ovulation or LH dates. Initial rise means the clinically established LH-associated rise, not simply the first high test. Leave unknown dates blank. These dates estimate a window, not an exact birth date.
repro_multiple_results: Multiple results on the latest date — review together
repro_range_luteal: Higher / luteal reference range — timing needs confirmation
repro_range_transition: Between reference ranges — review serial results
repro_range_high: Above reference ranges — value alone cannot date fertility
repro_trend_insufficient: Trend: results on different dates are needed; same-day results require review.
repro_trend_falling: Latest numerical trend: falling; review with your vet.
repro_serial_guidance: Approximate ranges are not proof of LH surge, ovulation or a breeding day. Interpret serial tests with your vet, using sampling dates, clinical findings and laboratory/analyzer variability. Numerical changes between assays may not be biological changes.
repro_excluded_samples: Some results were excluded: missing/invalid unit, value or date, or a future date. Review the original reports.
repro_frozen_guidance: Frozen-thawed sperm has a very short functional life. About 8–12 hours is an educational reference, not a guaranteed lifespan or a maximum; reports and samples vary. Use precise LH/ovulation timing, serial results and post-thaw quality. A single progesterone cutoff never decides when to inseminate.
repro_chilled_guidance: Chilled/extended semen has reduced, variable longevity compared with high-quality fresh semen. Original quality, extender, transport time, temperature and handling matter. No fixed 3- or 5-day survival is guaranteed; coordinate shipment and timing with your vet.
repro_fresh_guidance: Fresh/natural semen usually has the longest functional survival. Normal fresh canine sperm may remain viable about 7–9 days, sometimes longer, permitting earlier deposition before oocyte maturation. This is not a guaranteed lifespan for an individual sample.
repro_semen_unknown: Select semen type in the breeding plan; its quality and survival affect insemination timing.
repro_days_since: {days} days since {basis}. Review this recorded timing with serial results; it is not an automatic breeding instruction.
repro_timing_unknown: LH/ovulation timing is not recorded. A single test or calendar heat day cannot establish it.
repro_heat_guidance: Heat forecasts are rough planning estimates. Cycle day alone does not identify a fertile window. Discuss progesterone testing and/or vaginal cytology with your vet.
repro_reference_ranges: Approximate reference ranges; interpret serial results with your vet.
repro_ultrasound_body: {name}: around 28 days since mating. Discuss pregnancy confirmation by ultrasound with your vet.
repro_whelping_body: {name}: estimated whelping window {start}–{end}, if pregnant. Review preparations and monitoring with your vet; the birth date is not exact.
repro_testing_body: {name}: recorded heat day {day}. Fertility cannot be timed from this day alone. Consider serial progesterone testing and/or vaginal cytology with your vet; follow their testing schedule.
repro_heat_body: {name}: next heat roughly estimated near {date}. Observe signs; this calendar estimate does not predict ovulation.
repro_timing_support: Scheduling guidance only: your reproduction vet must confirm the actual insemination time. These date ranges are not sperm-survival guarantees.
repro_oocyte_sequence: Oocytes are ovulated immature. Conceptually: LH/initial rise → about 2–3 days → ovulation → another 2–3 days → oocyte maturation. Individual timing varies.
repro_confidence_calendar: Timing confidence: low, calendar only. Heat start does not establish Day 0; no dated insemination window can be calculated.
repro_confidence_unknown: Timing confidence: insufficient information to date a breeding window.
repro_confidence_recorded: Timing confidence: limited to recorded clinical dates; supporting serial results are incomplete or need review.
repro_confidence_serial: Timing confidence: recorded clinical dates plus a rising numerical series. This does not independently confirm ovulation or assay comparability.
repro_confidence_review: Timing confidence: review required. Dated insemination suggestions are withheld because the recorded data need clinical review.
repro_breeding_window: Suggested timing to review with your vet: {window}
repro_chilled_option: Alternative chilled-semen schedule: {first} and {second}. Choose one schedule with your vet; these are separate appointments.
repro_day_zero_basis: Timing basis: recorded LH/clinical initial rise = Day 0. Fresh: approximately Days 3–6; chilled: Days 3 & 5 or 4 & 6; frozen-thawed: approximately Day 5 or 6. Clinical context may change the plan.
repro_ovulation_basis: Timing basis: recorded ovulation. Approximate discussion windows: fresh +1–4 days; chilled +1 & +3 or +2 & +4 days; frozen-thawed +3–4 days. No exact LH date is inferred.
repro_technique_conflict: Natural mating conflicts with chilled/frozen semen. Review the insemination technique before using a dated schedule.
repro_technique_review: Confirm deposition technique with your reproduction vet. Frozen-thawed semen especially requires an appropriate technique; choosing a method does not prove suitability or move biological dates.
repro_quality_unknown: Semen quality is not recorded. Have quality, handling and post-thaw assessment reviewed where applicable.
repro_quality_review: Recorded semen quality requires veterinary interpretation. Reduced quality may invalidate standard timing suggestions; the app does not invent a lifespan or shift ovulation.

health_core_guidance: Core puppy planning: start around 6–8 weeks, repeat every 2–4 weeks, and continue until a primary dose is given at 16 weeks or older. Maternal antibodies can interfere. Confirm the individual/product plan; higher risk may require continuation.
health_rabies_guidance: Rabies scheduling depends on local law, licensed product, minimum age and travel rules. Enter the verified next date or veterinary/product interval; no worldwide schedule is assumed.
health_lepto_guidance: Leptospirosis has its own primary series and boosters. Multiple primary doses may be required. Regional recommendations and the licensed product determine the plan; do not reuse the viral core schedule automatically.
health_bordetella_guidance: Bordetella timing, minimum age and number of doses depend on the product and intranasal, oral or injectable route. Confirm the product label and veterinary recommendation; route alone does not define a schedule.
health_risk_vaccine_guidance: Assess lifestyle, geographic exposure and veterinary advice for this vaccine. It is not automatically required for every dog. Enter a product-specific series or individual next date.
health_unknown_vaccine: Vaccine type/protocol is unknown or custom. No next dose can be inferred safely. Choose the documented type or enter the veterinary/product plan.
health_birth_required: A reliable actual birth date and consistent treatment/weaning dates are needed for age-based planning. Expected litter dates are not actual birth dates.
health_early_core_review: This dose was recorded before the usual 6-week starting age. Review the actual product and veterinary protocol; no automatic next date is generated.
health_core_age_met: A dose is recorded at 16 weeks or older. This meets the age criterion, not proof of immunity or a complete lifetime plan. Confirm the series and subsequent booster plan with the veterinarian.
health_high_risk_review: A dose is recorded at 16 weeks or older with higher risk selected. The veterinarian may advise continuation. No universal later final age or booster date is assumed.
health_invalid_interval: The general puppy core interval is 14–28 days. Other intervals require an individual veterinary/product plan.
health_puppy_worm_guidance: General early roundworm control: start around day 14 and repeat about every 14 days until about 14 days after known weaning. This is not a lifetime plan; further testing/treatment depends on risk and veterinary advice.
health_weaning_unknown: Early puppy roundworm guidance uses approximately 14-day intervals. Weaning date is unknown, so the endpoint cannot be calculated. Do not assume an 8-week stop or continue this early-phase plan indefinitely; confirm weaning and follow-up with the veterinarian.
health_early_worm_review: Treatment was recorded before approximately day 14. Confirm the exact product and veterinary plan; no automatic next interval is inferred.
health_after_weaning: The next 14-day step falls beyond the early-phase endpoint. Do not shorten a product interval automatically. Review completion and the subsequent testing/prevention plan with the veterinarian.
health_adult_parasite_guidance: Parasite prevention is individualized by exposure, lifestyle, location and fecal-testing strategy. Select a documented treatment/testing plan or enter the next date. No universal quarterly interval is assumed.
health_external_guidance: Flea/tick products differ in approved age, weight, formulation, target parasites and duration. Follow the local product label/veterinarian. Enter a verified interval or manual next date; no universal 8-week minimum or 30-day interval is assumed. This app does not verify product eligibility or calculate doses.
health_heartworm_guidance: Heartworm prevention and testing depend on geography, exposure and the specific product. Enter the veterinary/product plan; early puppy roundworm intervals must not be reused.
health_demo_record: Example only — not a saved health record or a due date. Open the dog or litter health records for actual entries.
nutrition_no_dogs: No dogs found. Manual calculation remains available in the Daily Calculator.

guide_step_0_body: Start with a dog profile. Keep identification and four generations of ancestry together.
guide_step_1_body: Follow health records, matings, pregnancy and litters from your dogs’ records.
guide_step_2_body: Bring dates, events, travel and finances together. Keep feeding plans and notes close at hand.
guide_step_3_body: Add up to six tools to Home and arrange them as you prefer. Help & support is always available from More.
guide_dogs_body: Open Dogs to add a profile. Keep names, identification, pedigree and health records together. Review imported information before saving.
guide_litters_body: Open Litters to plan a litter and track parents, puppies and records. Available management tools follow your account plan.
guide_breeding_body: Open Breeding from the Admin panel or Home if added. Use Stud dogs for males and Breeding females for females. Reproduction remains a fixed card in each dog profile. Record heat cycles, progesterone results and mating; check units and dates. Estimates support planning and do not replace veterinary advice.
guide_health_body: Keep vaccines, tests and health reminders in each dog’s records. Verify dates and document details.
guide_pedigree_body: Open Pedigree in a dog profile to review parents and four generations of ancestors. Check full names and relationships before saving an import.
guide_scanner_body: Choose Smart Scan for the camera, Upload for a gallery image or an Excel/CSV file, or QR to read a code. Review the extracted details before saving. The importer currently supports pedigrees; genetic and health documents are not yet supported.
guide_scanner_short: Import pedigrees from document images or spreadsheet files
guide_shows_body: Open Events & Travel from the Admin panel or Home if added. Enter the trip name and date. Use Add event for its type and name. Add stops in order, including the return stop if needed. Check distances, vehicle and fuel details, then each cost and the total. You can enter accommodation at several stops. Missing routes or fuel details leave the estimate incomplete. Save and tap a trip for its summary; use the three dots to edit or delete. Dated trips appear in Calendar. Save linked costs separately in Finances.
guide_shows_short: Events, multi-stop trips and itemized costs
guide_travel_body: Open Events & Travel from the Admin panel or Home if added. Enter the trip name and date. Use Add event for its type and name. Add stops in order, including the return stop if needed. Check distances, vehicle and fuel details, then each cost and the total. You can enter accommodation at several stops. Missing routes or fuel details leave the estimate incomplete. Save and tap a trip for its summary; use the three dots to edit or delete. Dated trips appear in Calendar. Save linked costs separately in Finances.
guide_community_body: Open Community for Forum, Rooms and Messages. Hold a message or comment to see available actions, including Copy; open a photo to download it. Tap links to open them. In direct messages, Seen and the recipient’s avatar appear after reading while Online; Busy and Offline do not send new read receipts. Forum topics and comments can be translated on your device, with the original one tap away. The first translation may need a language download over Wi-Fi; Rooms and Messages are not translated. Community text, including private messages and private rooms, is checked automatically before publication. Owners and moderators cannot browse private conversations through moderation tools. Automated checks may make mistakes; use Help & support or Request review to dispute a restriction. Only account-linked moderation metadata is kept for abuse prevention and review; rejected private-message text is not stored in moderation logs.
guide_community_short: Free Forum, Rooms, Friends and Messages
guide_calendar_body: Open Calendar from the Admin panel or add it to Home. Month and agenda views collect dated health, breeding, litter, Notes, Events & Travel, task and reminder records. Named travel entries show the event and trip names. Filter and tap an entry to open its source. Edit or remove the original record there; Calendar does not create a separate copy.
guide_backup_body: Open Backup & privacy from the profile menu. Create backup saves private records, including Finances, and supported attachments in a ZIP. Choose a location and check the result. Restore adds missing records, keeps existing ones and reports conflicts; it does not overwrite them. Personal data export is for viewing, not restoring. Keep the unencrypted ZIP in a secure location.
guide_account_body: Open Settings from the profile menu to choose language, appearance, default currency and security options. The chosen currency is the default for new amounts; existing records keep their saved currency and are not converted. Manage biometric unlock on supported devices. Use Forgot password on sign-in to reset a password; changing it while signed in requires the current password.
guide_progesterone_body: Record the sample date, value and unit. Check the laboratory result before saving. Interpret trends with your veterinarian; a single value does not guarantee ovulation.

guide_home_body: Home gives quick access to up to six tools. Use Edit to choose and reorder them. The Admin panel contains the tool catalog, including Calendar and Finances. Removing a Home shortcut does not delete your records.
guide_finance_body: Open Finances from the Admin panel, Home if added, or a dog’s profile. Enter income or expenses with amount, currency, category and payment status; link a dog or litter if relevant. Review totals by dog, litter, category or year. Estimates and unpaid amounts stay separate from paid totals; currencies are not combined. Linked costs require your review and Save. Using the same source again does not create duplicates.
guide_calendar_short: Dates, tasks and reminders in one view
guide_nutrition_body: Open Nutrition from the Admin panel or Home if added. In Daily food calculator, select a dog and review weight, activity and feeding details. In Prime Recipe, choose ingredients and quantities, check energy values, then save or use the recipe in the calculator. Complete missing weight or energy data before calculating. Calculated quantities do not certify that a recipe is nutritionally complete.
guide_notes_body: Open Notes from the Admin panel or Home if added. Create a note, write your text and attach photos as needed. Save your changes. Add a dated reminder when action is needed; it appears in Calendar. Removing an attached photo does not delete the whole note.
guide_stud_body: Open Breeding → Stud dogs from the Admin panel or Home if added. Manage your stud’s status and breeding information. In the male dog’s Reproduction section, record the bitch and mating dates; add further dates to the same mating record. Review any stud fee before saving it as linked income in Finances.
guide_pregnancy_body: Open Pregnancy for a bitch to review her timeline, checks and estimated whelping date. The estimate uses a recorded ovulation date when available; otherwise it uses mating dates. Check those dates in Reproduction before relying on the timeline. Record examinations and the actual birth as they happen. An estimated date is not confirmation of pregnancy.
guide_results_body: Open Show results & titles in a dog’s profile to record exhibitions, results, awards and champion titles. Enter the event details and the titles actually awarded. Use the record menu to edit or delete an entry. These are the dog’s achievements; upcoming events and travel plans belong in Events & Travel.
guide_marketplace_body: The current Marketplace screen shows example listings. Location, map and contact actions are not a live directory or booking service. Do not use these examples as verified providers. Manage your own stud records in Stud Dogs.
guide_analytics_details: Pedigree COI uses recorded ancestry and is not genomic COI. Missing founders are assumed unrelated and non-inbred. Always read COI with depth and completeness. AVK distinguishes unique identities, repeated slots and missing information. Contribution sums expected inheritance paths, not measured DNA. Review name-only identities explicitly. Trial Mating and comparison are hypothetical, require Trial or Premium, and never create a litter or recommend breeding.
guide_contracts_details: Create or adapt a sample template. From a buyer, select a puppy and review parties, terms and amounts. Lock the contract, then explicitly consent and sign. Buyer signing uses a restricted same-device session and signs out on exit. Preview, print or share the signed PDF and verify its recorded hash. Signed content cannot be edited: void with a reason or create a replacement. Shared contracts can also be reviewed and signed through Shared dogs when access has been granted. The legal effect of electronic signatures may depend on applicable law, jurisdiction and circumstances. Prime Breeder provides contract preparation, signing evidence and document integrity features. It does not replace local legal advice.
pedigree_local_no_names: No ancestor names could be mapped reliably. Try a clearer, straight photo. Your saved pedigree is unchanged.
pedigree_local_review: Review the ancestor names against the original. Replacing saved names requires your confirmation. You can edit any name; nothing is saved until you press Save.
pedigree_cloud_processing: Smart Scan sends the selected pedigree image to Google Cloud Vision to read dog names. Review the results before saving.
pedigree_cloud_image_too_large: This image exceeds the scan size limit. Choose a smaller original image; it will not be reduced automatically.
pedigree_cloud_quota_reached: You have used your available pedigree scans for this period.
pedigree_cloud_usage_limit: The current scan limit has been reached. Please try again later.
pedigree_cloud_rate_limit: Please wait a few seconds before starting another scan.
pedigree_cloud_attempt_processed: This scan attempt has already been processed. No duplicate request was sent.
reports_error: The report could not be created. Please try again.
reports_cash_basis: Received and paid totals follow payment dates. Outstanding balances are shown as of export.
repro_unsuccessful_confirm: Record this attempt as unsuccessful? All mating and monitoring records will be kept.
repro_correct_outcome_confirm: Undo the unsuccessful outcome and resume follow-up for this same attempt?
repro_outcome_conflict: This attempt already has a confirmed pregnancy, birth or another outcome. Correct the existing record first.
repro_next_heat_insufficient: Not enough cycle history to estimate the next heat.
repro_delete_heat_details: Deleting this heat also deletes its progesterone tests, mating records and pregnancy tracking. This cannot be undone.
breeding_active_hint: Set Active in My Dogs → dog profile → Reproduction to show a dog here.
pedigree_web_setup_required: Web scanning is not configured yet. Your saved pedigree has not changed.
guide_scanner_web_body: Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP pedigree image from your computer. The scanner proposes dog names in the existing ancestor fields. Review and correct the names before saving. Your saved pedigree changes only after you confirm Save.
pm_withdrawal_notice: Your account now uses Free Forever. Your eligible records and text Community remain available. New cloud uploads and professional actions require active Trial or Premium. Historical media is preserved, ordinary paid media access is subject to membership restrictions. You can export your personal data. No automatic deletion date has been set.
mod_search: Email, user ID or public name
mod_warning: Your text contains language that is not permitted in Prime Breeder Community. Please revise it before sending.
mod_restricted: Community participation is temporarily restricted. You can request a review through Help & support.
mod_banned: Community access is restricted. You can request a review through Help & support.
mod_appeal_sent: Your review request has been recorded.
mod_privacy: Community text, including private messages and private rooms, is checked automatically before publication. Owners and moderators cannot browse private conversations through moderation tools. Automated checks may make mistakes; use Help & support or Request review to dispute a restriction. Only account-linked moderation metadata is kept for abuse prevention and review; rejected private-message text is not stored in moderation logs.
mod_proposal: Automatic escalation is off until an owner explicitly approves it. Proposed: 3 violations / 24 hours → 10-minute mute; 6 → 24-hour suspension. No automatic permanent bans.

pm_gifts_invalid_email: Enter the email address of the recipient’s account.

pm_gifts_stale: The gift changed. Refresh and try again.
